description: HP-52 is the Regional Transport Office serving the Shimla Rural region, headquartered in Kasumpti. It operates as a Registration and Licensing Authority (R&LA) to manage vehicle registrations and driving permits for the rural outskirts of the state capital. This office plays a vital role in local transport administration, ensuring decentralized services for the residents of the Shimla district.
address: Office of the Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM), Shimla (Rural), Kasumpti, Shimla, Himachal Pradesh
